DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Fifteen Kilos on a Bed

STS-HS11-L2-13001400-HSSCIENG1112-STP-IMR-01 • HS Science Engineering Design 11-12 • Qualitative and Quantitative Criteria and Constraints
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
In a pitch competition a team gets a few minutes to convince judges to fund one design and nothing else. Farida, Omid, and Zarina took every number on that board from their own first week in this city, when each of them arrived with one bag and did homework on a flattened cardboard box. Fifty five centimeters is the size the airline let them carry. Fifteen kilos is what a stack of borrowed schoolbooks weighs.
The judges add one more requirement. The desk has to feel steady when you lean on it. Is that something you can measure with a number, or something you can only describe in words? Say which, and say why.
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Farida doing?
Look at the picture. Describe Farida's action in one complete sentence, using an exact verb and an exact word for what she reaches toward.
2
What is Omid holding?
Look at the picture. Describe the object in Omid's hands in one complete sentence, using exact words for its material and its shape.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Describe the teacher's action in one complete sentence, naming the tool and the surface he works across.
4
What place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Describe this place in one complete sentence, naming two exact objects that belong in it.
5
Tell me about the board.
Look at the picture. Describe the board in one complete sentence, naming both of its headings exactly as they are written.
6
What is Zarina wearing?
Look at the picture. Describe Zarina's clothing in one complete sentence, using exact words for its color and its type.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: NGSS HS-ETS1-1 — Analyze a major global challenge to specify qualitative and quantitative criteria and constraints for solutions. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
